title: Remove Logo from Image Online | AI Logo Remover
description: Remove unwanted logos from images you own or can edit. Clean visible brand marks on product photos, clothing or graphics online, then preview and download a JPG.
heading: Remove Logo from Image Online with AI
intro:
Need to update an old brand asset or clean a logo from a photo you are authorized to edit? WatermarkGemini can process the visible mark while aiming to keep nearby product edges, lighting and background detail intact. Check the result before using it in a new layout.

The comparison images on this page are illustrative examples, not tested product outputs.

process.heading: How to Remove a Logo from an Image Online
process.intro: Follow the three steps below. Always confirm the file type and actual processing status shown in the tool before you submit content.

steps.title: Upload a Photo with a Visible Logo
steps.description: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 10 MB. A clear original with enough surrounding detail gives the tool better information than a compressed screenshot.

steps.title: Process the Logo Area
steps.description: Sign in with Google and review the displayed cost. Start the image cleanup and let the tool attempt to blend the edited surface with adjacent color and texture.

steps.title: Compare and Download Your Image
steps.description: Inspect brand edges, reflections, labels and product contours in the result. Download the JPG when you are satisfied and have the rights to use the edited image.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Removing Logos from Images
faq.intro: Clear answers about supported inputs, editing quality, limits and responsible use.

items.question: How do I remove a logo from an image online?
items.answer: Upload your permitted JPG, PNG or WebP image, sign in, review the processing cost and run the cleanup. Check the reconstructed region in the preview and download the resulting JPG. Use the original design file when possible if the logo remains an editable layer.

items.question: Can I remove a logo from an image online for free?
items.answer: Limited free allowances may be available, but the uploader displays any processing cost before the job begins. Google sign-in is required. Use only an eligible free allowance or available balance shown by the current processing quote.

items.question: Will the AI logo remover blur my photo?
items.answer: The process aims to reconstruct the marked area rather than merely apply a blur box. Large marks, reflections, faces and complex textures may still produce uneven details. Preview the result before publishing.

items.question: Can I remove a brand logo from a product image?
items.answer: Yes, for images and branding you own or are explicitly authorized to edit—for example, an approved rebrand. Removing someone else's trademark or attribution does not give you permission to sell or reuse their image.

items.question: Can I remove a logo from a photo on iPhone or Android?
items.answer: The page can be opened in a compatible mobile browser. Select an image on your device, complete the required Google sign-in and review the processed output. Performance depends on your browser and connection.

items.question: What image formats and file sizes are supported?
items.answer: The current image workflow accepts JPG, PNG and WebP files up to 10 MB and exports JPG. Check the uploader in case these limits change.

items.question: What if the cleaned logo area looks distorted?
items.answer: Try a higher-quality source, inspect whether the logo covers a large or highly patterned surface, and consider editing the original layered asset. Complex curved reflections or fabric may require manual retouching.

features.heading: AI Logo Remover for Product Photos and Detailed Backgrounds
features.intro:
Logo cleanup should address the surface beneath the mark, not just hide the mark behind a soft blur. These examples illustrate useful image types.

The comparison images on this page are illustrative examples, not tested product outputs.

items.heading: Remove Old Brand Logos from Product Images
items.description:
When you are updating a catalog or refreshing your own product photography, an outdated logo may be baked into the image. WatermarkGemini can attempt to clean the visible mark while preserving nearby shape and color. Confirm that the logo belongs to you or that you have permission to change the supplier or partner branding.

Illustrative scene: Leather sneaker; not a tested product output.
items.imageAlt: Illustrative Leather sneaker comparison; not a tested product output.

items.heading: Clean Visible Logos Without Cropping or Blur Boxes
items.description:
Cropping a corner may cut into the subject, while a blur box makes the edit obvious. Work on the marked region instead, then examine the newly generated background at normal size and zoomed in. Strong textures, large high-contrast marks and faces can produce artifacts; results are not pixel-perfect by default.

Illustrative scene: Cotton hoodie; not a tested product output.
items.imageAlt: Illustrative Cotton hoodie comparison; not a tested product output.

items.heading: Handle Logos on Packaging, Fabric and Reflective Surfaces
items.description:
A flat label on a white wall differs from printing across a curved bottle or a woven bag. Fabric, glass and cardboard can require different levels of retouching. Check highlights, seams and repeating lines after cleanup, especially for commercial assets.
